flags.text: Display needs review by the Cheyenne and Arapaho Tribes (see research/consultation-plan.md). The whole camp is a draft until then.
The lodge shapes and the way the cover is folded need checking against Cheyenne practice.
The travois sizes and the load are approximate. Check the load and how it was packed.
The horses are placeholders. Breed, tack and colour are not claimed. Check with consultants before any display.
The people are placeholder forms only. They must not stand in for real people. Review before any display.
The bluff is invented to frame the camp. It has no source.
Shrubs are generic. Their size and count are not measured.
Grass tufts are decoration. Their size is not measured.
Stones are generic. Their size is not measured.
The cottonwoods are generic. Heights and crowns are not measured.
The fire ring size is typical, and the cold ash is an assumption.
The bones show the herds were gone. Their number and placement are a scene choice; sources give the bone trade, not this camp.
Bundles and pots are generic. Their contents are not known.
